## Scope

Identify the repositories, projects, releases, versions, or artifacts being verified.

## Verification level

- [ ] Observed
- [ ] Reproduced
- [ ] Matched

## Method

Describe the comparison, tool, command, or evidence chain.

## Expected result

State the expected identity, relationship, hash, or behavior.

## Actual result

Record what was obtained.
